meta.heldout: CP-0501..CP-0505 are held out (split 'heldout'): written after the dev/test evaluation by a helper that did not see the reader or drafter code; same schedule and contract A rules. Do not tune on them.

cases.title: Stage lift pit added at addition per Owner direction
cases.narrative: Owner's Representative directed a hydraulic stage lift in the addition's multipurpose room. The lift needs a pit, excavated, formed and poured with the foundations. Concrete sub prices the pit.
cases.scope_context: Drawing S-101 shows a flat slab on grade at the multipurpose room; no pit.

lines.desc: Pit walls and slab, formed and poured

time.narrative: The pit must be built after the footings and foundation walls and before the slab on grade is poured over the area. New activity F-0401A, Excavate, form and pour stage lift pit, takes 6 working days. F-0401A cannot start until A1420 (Footings and foundation walls - addition) finishes. A1430 (Slab on grade - addition) cannot start until F-0401A finishes. CM requests 11 calendar days of time extension and extended general conditions for those days.

activities.name: Excavate, form and pour stage lift pit

cases.title: Field-modified gym truss bearings per RFI-214
cases.narrative: RFI-214 asked how the gym roof trusses bear on the existing masonry wall. Architect's response corrects a detailing error and requires new slotted bearing assemblies to be field-welded after the trusses are set.
cases.scope_context: Drawing S-301 detail 4 shows a standard bearing plate, which conflicts with the existing wall's anchor layout.

time.narrative: The field welding can start 15 working days after steel erection starts, when the gym trusses are set, and the metal deck cannot start until the welding is done and inspected. New activity F-0402A, Field-weld revised gym truss bearing assemblies (RFI-214), takes 4 working days. F-0402A cannot start until 15 working days after A1460 (Erect structural steel - addition) starts. A1470 (Metal deck and elevated slab - addition) cannot start until F-0402A finishes. CM requests 7 calendar days of time extension and extended general conditions for those days.

activities.name: Field-weld revised gym truss bearing assemblies (RFI-214)

cases.title: Acoustic wall panels in addition music room
cases.narrative: Owner added fabric-wrapped acoustic wall panels and wall blocking in the addition's music and band rooms.
cases.scope_context: Spec 09 84 00 is not in the project manual; drawings show painted gypsum board in rooms 205 and 206.

time.narrative: The panels go on after the addition is painted and must be complete before the ceiling grid goes in, because the panels run to the deck. New activity F-0403A, Install acoustic wall panels - addition music rooms, takes 7 working days. F-0403A cannot start until A1760 (Painting - addition) finishes. A1740 (Ceilings - addition) cannot start until F-0403A finishes. CM requests 7 working days of time extension and extended general conditions for those days.

activities.name: Install acoustic wall panels - addition music rooms

cases.title: Added play structure at primary playground
cases.narrative: Owner added a second play structure and its safety surfacing at the primary playground.
cases.scope_context: Drawing L-201 shows one play structure.

time.narrative: The new structure is installed after the playground and play surfacing work and must be finished before final striping and site cleanup. New activity F-0404A, Install added play structure and surfacing, takes 10 working days. F-0404A cannot start until A2140 (Playground and play surfacing) finishes. A2170 (Striping and final site cleanup) cannot start until F-0404A finishes. CM requests 14 calendar days of time extension and extended general conditions for those days.

activities.name: Install added play structure and surfacing

cases.title: Revised casework blocking per ASI-061
cases.narrative: ASI-061 moves the Wing A classroom casework to the opposite walls. Framing sub adds blocking and patches the moved locations.
cases.scope_context: Drawing A-401 shows casework on the corridor walls of rooms 110 to 118.

time.narrative: The blocking work follows the Wing A framing and drywall and has to be done before painting in the existing building starts. New activity F-0405A, Rework casework blocking - Wing A (ASI-061), takes 8 working days. F-0405A cannot start until A1700 (Framing and drywall - Wing A) finishes. A1750 (Painting - existing building) cannot start until F-0405A finishes. CM requests 12 calendar days of time extension and extended general conditions for those days.

activities.name: Rework casework blocking - Wing A (ASI-061)

cases.title: PV-ready roof upgrade at addition
cases.narrative: Owner directed a PV-ready roof at the addition: added blocking, conduit sleeves and thicker insulation under the membrane.
cases.scope_context: Spec 07 54 23 covers a standard TPO roof with R-30 insulation and no solar provisions.

time.narrative: The added blocking and insulation work starts after the metal deck and elevated slab are complete, and the roofing membrane cannot start until it is done. CM's claim counts the whole 12 working days of added work. New activity F-0406A, PV-ready blocking and added roof insulation - addition, takes 12 working days. F-0406A cannot start until A1470 (Metal deck and elevated slab - addition) finishes. A1520 (Roofing - addition) cannot start until F-0406A finishes. CM requests 17 calendar days of time extension and extended general conditions for those days.

activities.name: PV-ready blocking and added roof insulation - addition

cases.title: Storefront head subframing per RFI-233
cases.narrative: RFI-233 response revises the storefront head detail at the addition and adds steel subframing above every storefront opening.
cases.scope_context: Drawing A-501 detail 7 shows storefront heads anchored directly to the framing.

time.narrative: The subframing goes in after the exterior framing and sheathing at the addition and must be in place before windows and storefront can be set. New activity F-0407A, Install storefront head subframing (RFI-233), takes 4 working days. F-0407A cannot start until A1510 (Exterior framing and sheathing - addition) finishes. A1530 (Windows and storefront - addition) cannot start until F-0407A finishes. CM requests 21 calendar days of time extension and extended general conditions for those days.

activities.name: Install storefront head subframing (RFI-233)

cases.title: Rerouted sprinkler mains per ASI-070
cases.narrative: ASI-070 reroutes the addition's sprinkler mains around the revised duct mains and adds two zones.
cases.scope_context: Drawing FP-201 shows the mains running through the corridor ceiling space.

time.narrative: The rerouting follows the addition's sprinkler rough-in and must be done before the in-wall and above-ceiling inspections for the addition. New activity F-0408A, Reroute sprinkler mains - addition (ASI-070), takes 9 working days. F-0408A cannot start until A1640 (Fire sprinkler rough-in - addition) finishes. A1685 (In-wall and above-ceiling inspections - addition) cannot start until F-0408A finishes. CM requests 14 calendar days of time extension and extended general conditions for those days.

activities.name: Reroute sprinkler mains - addition (ASI-070)

cases.title: Steel erection start: erector crane availability
cases.narrative: The steel erector advised that its crawler crane is committed to another job and will arrive 5 working days later than planned. CM asks for time and the erector's standby cost.
cases.scope_context: Subcontract with the erector requires mobilization within 3 days of notice.

time.narrative: The crane wait sits between the slab on grade and the start of steel erection: erection cannot start until the crane arrives, and the wait begins when the slab is done. New activity F-0409A, Wait for erector's crane (erector's commitment elsewhere), takes 5 working days. F-0409A cannot start until A1430 (Slab on grade - addition) finishes. A1460 (Erect structural steel - addition) cannot start until F-0409A finishes. CM requests 7 calendar days of time extension, time only.

activities.name: Wait for erector's crane (erector's commitment elsewhere)

cases.title: Flatwork crew shortage at site
cases.narrative: The flatwork sub reports a crew shortage and will start curbs and sidewalks 8 working days late. CM asks for time only.
cases.scope_context: Subcontract schedule requires flatwork to follow site electrical directly.

time.narrative: The late start sits after the site electrical and lighting conduit work and before curbs, sidewalks and flatwork. New activity F-0410A, Flatwork crew unavailable (subcontractor shortage), takes 8 working days. F-0410A cannot start until A2110 (Site electrical and lighting conduit) finishes. A2130 (Curbs, sidewalks and flatwork) cannot start until F-0410A finishes. CM requests 10 calendar days of time extension, time only.

activities.name: Flatwork crew unavailable (subcontractor shortage)

cases.title: Abnormal rainfall at addition excavation
cases.narrative: Rainfall in early June 2020 was well above the ten-year average at the nearest NOAA station and flooded the addition footprint. CM pumped the site and asks for time only.
cases.scope_context: Daily reports and NOAA data attached.

time.narrative: The weather days fall after the haul-off and clearing of the addition footprint and before excavation and shoring can start. New activity F-0411A, Weather standby - abnormal rainfall at addition footprint, takes 4 working days. F-0411A cannot start until A1340 (Haul-off and clear addition footprint) finishes. A1400 (Excavation and shoring - addition) cannot start until F-0411A finishes. CM requests 7 calendar days of time extension, time only.

activities.name: Weather standby - abnormal rainfall at addition footprint

cases.title: Flooded underslab utility trench
cases.narrative: A second abnormal storm flooded the open underslab utility trench at the addition. The trench has to be dewatered, re-excavated and the bedding replaced. CM asks for time only.
cases.scope_context: Daily reports and NOAA data attached.

time.narrative: The recovery work follows the underslab utilities and must be finished before the slab on grade is poured. CM's claim counts all 15 working days of recovery work. New activity F-0412A, Dewater and re-excavate flooded underslab utility trench, takes 15 working days. F-0412A cannot start until A1410 (Underslab utilities - addition) finishes. A1430 (Slab on grade - addition) cannot start until F-0412A finishes. CM requests 21 calendar days of time extension, time only.

activities.name: Dewater and re-excavate flooded underslab utility trench

cases.title: Classroom flooring change (concurrent with crew shortage)
cases.narrative: Owner changed the addition classroom flooring from VCT to rubber tile, which adds a resubmittal and longer lead time. Separately, the flooring sub has told CM it will be short a crew for the same period.
cases.scope_context: Spec 09 65 19 specifies VCT in classrooms 201 to 212.

time.narrative: Both delays fall between the addition ceilings and the addition classroom flooring. The Owner's change adds 6 working days for the resubmittal and delivery; the sub's crew shortage would by itself also hold the flooring start by 6 working days, over the same period. New activity F-0413A, Resubmit and deliver rubber flooring (Owner change), takes 6 working days. New activity F-0413B, Flooring crew shortage (subcontractor), takes 6 working days. F-0413A cannot start until A1740 (Ceilings - addition) finishes. A1790 (Flooring - addition classrooms) cannot start until F-0413A finishes. F-0413B cannot start until A1740 (Ceilings - addition) finishes. A1790 (Flooring - addition classrooms) cannot start until F-0413B finishes. CM requests 11 calendar days of time extension and extended general conditions for those days.

activities.name: Resubmit and deliver rubber flooring (Owner change)
Flooring crew shortage (subcontractor)

cases.title: Sunshades at existing windows per ASI-075
cases.narrative: ASI-075 adds aluminum sunshades above the south-facing replacement windows in the existing building.
cases.scope_context: Drawing A-210 shows no sunshades on the existing building.

time.narrative: The sunshades are installed after the existing-building window replacement and before exterior painting and sealants. CM requests no time. New activity F-0414A, Install sunshades - existing building (ASI-075), takes 6 working days. F-0414A cannot start until A1560 (Window replacement - existing building) finishes. A1580 (Exterior painting and sealants - existing building) cannot start until F-0414A finishes. CM requests no extension of time.

activities.name: Install sunshades - existing building (ASI-075)

cases.title: Added data drops in Wing B offices
cases.narrative: Owner added 16 data drops in the Wing B administration offices. Work fits in the existing MEP rough-in for Wing B.
cases.scope_context: Drawing T-102 shows 20 data drops in Wing B offices.

time.narrative: No schedule activities are added; the drops are installed by the existing crew within MEP rough-in - Wing B. CM requests no time. No new activities are added to the schedule. CM requests no extension of time.

cases.title: Convert addition storage room 231 to IDF with dedicated cooling
cases.narrative: District IT asked, and the Owner's Representative directed by email, that storage room 231 in the addition become an intermediate distribution frame (IDF) room with its own ductless split cooling unit, a dedicated 30-amp circuit and a fire-rated plywood backboard.
cases.scope_context: Drawings M-201 and E-201 show room 231 as unconditioned storage with one convenience outlet.

time.narrative: Room 231 sits in the middle of the second-floor rough-in area of the new wing. The added line set, condensate drain, dedicated circuit and rated penetrations for the IDF can't go in until our MEP rough-in up there is otherwise complete, because the mechanical and electrical crews work that whole floor in sequence, and all of it has to be in before the in-wall and above-ceiling inspection for the new wing. Mechanical and electrical together figure 5 working days for the added rough-in. Run against the June update, this pushes Substantial Completion. CM requests 10 calendar days of time extension and extended general conditions for those days.

activities.name: Added IDF rough-in: line set, condensate, dedicated circuit, rated penetrations - addition

cases.title: Collector straps and drag struts at Wing B roof per ASI-088
cases.narrative: ASI-088 adds steel collector straps and two drag struts at the Wing B roof diaphragm to complete the load path to the new shear walls.
cases.scope_context: Drawing S-402 shows the Wing B shear walls with no collectors at the roof diaphragm.

time.narrative: Time impact analysis against schedule update 2020-06-01. Fragnet inserted: F-0502A Install collector straps and drag struts - Wing B roof diaphragm (ASI-088), original duration 10 working days. Predecessor: A1490 Seismic upgrade - Wing B (finish-to-start, no lag). Successor: A1620 MEP rough-in - Wing B (finish-to-start, no lag); the MEP trades cannot work overhead in Wing B while the ironworkers are welding at the roof diaphragm. CM requests 15 calendar days of time extension and extended general conditions for those days.

activities.name: Install collector straps and drag struts - Wing B roof diaphragm (ASI-088)

cases.title: Moisture vapor mitigation coating at addition gym slab
cases.narrative: After reviewing the wood flooring manufacturer's warranty terms, the Owner directed CM to add a moisture vapor mitigation coating over the gym slab in the addition, in addition to the specified vapor retarder under the sleepers.
cases.scope_context: Spec 09 64 66 relies on a 6-mil poly vapor retarder under the sleepers; no slab coating is specified.

time.narrative: The gym wood floor installer won't start until the slab under it is coated and cured. We can't start the coating until the ceilings in the new wing are done, because the ceiling crew's lifts are on the gym floor until then. The coating work is RH testing, shot-blasting and two coats of epoxy, 9 working days, and then the manufacturer wants 5 working days of cure before the sleepers go down. That is 14 working days of added work in front of the gym floor, about three calendar weeks. CM requests 21 calendar days of time extension and extended general conditions for those days.

activities.name: RH test, shot-blast and apply vapor mitigation coating - gym slab
Cure vapor mitigation coating before gym wood floor

cases.title: Lowered corridor ceiling and soffits at addition per RFI-341
cases.narrative: RFI-341 reported that the supply duct mains in the addition's second-floor corridor clash with the beams at the specified ceiling height. Architect's response lowers the corridor ceiling 10 inches and adds framed soffits at the classroom doors.
cases.scope_context: Drawing A-521 shows the corridor ceiling at 9'-6" with no soffits.

lower_tier.scope: Lower sprinkler drops to new ceiling height

time.narrative: Per the RFI 341 answer (rec'd 7/16) the 2nd floor corridor lid in the new building comes down 10" and we get soffits at every classroom door. Talked to Rainier Mech - their guys drop and re-hang the branch ducts and the sprinkler sub lowers the heads at the same time, figure 3 working days, and they can't start until drywall in the new building is finished (they'd be fighting the tapers for the same lifts). After that our framers frame, board and tape the soffits, 5 working days. Painters were going to roll straight in behind the drywall in the new building and now they can't start until the soffits are done, and the ceiling grid and everything after it slides with them. Inspector says she'll look at the relocated duct the same morning we close it, so no extra time for the re-inspection. This is separate from RFI 327 (stair rail), which is answered and has no time. Requesting 8 working days and the extended general conditions that go with them.

activities.name: Relocate branch ducts and sprinkler drops for lowered corridor ceiling - addition
Frame, board and tape corridor soffits - addition (RFI-341)

cases.title: Access control integration by Owner's vendor (concurrent with controls retest)
cases.narrative: The Owner's separately contracted security vendor advised, through the Owner, that it cannot integrate the addition's access control with the fire alarm door releases until functional performance testing is complete. Separately, CM's controls subcontractor has told CM that its smoke-control sequence for the addition will need a correction and retest pass after functional testing.
cases.scope_context: The Owner's security vendor contract is outside CM's scope; Spec 23 09 93 requires the smoke-control sequence to pass functional testing before final inspection.

time.narrative: Both items fall in the same window at the end of the job: after functional performance testing and controls is finished and before the fire marshal and building official final inspections. The Owner's vendor needs 4 working days to integrate and demonstrate the door releases, and the fire marshal will not start the final inspection until that is done. Our controls sub's correction and retest of the smoke-control sequence also takes 4 working days over the same period, and the final inspection would wait for it too. CM requests 7 calendar days of time extension and extended general conditions for those days.

activities.name: Owner's security vendor: access control and door release integration - addition
Controls subcontractor: correct and retest smoke-control sequence - addition
